ratings.comment: He is an average professor, but a really nice, interesting guy.  He does a good job at making very very fair exams, so if chem 103 will be easy for you take him because the exams will not screw you.

His exams are tough and tricky. There is online homework. There is a quiz every discussion section. His lectures aren't very informative. Most of my learning was done by reading the text. He is funny and speaks clear, but overall his teaching style didn't suite my learning style.

Hutch was an overall good prof.  His lectures could sometimes be all over the place, but it all would tie together at the end. The tests were pretty difficult as they were problem based, but you do get to use a notecard.  The online homework helps a lot in understanding the material.

Hutch is a great lecturer. He really knows his stuff. His tests are insane, though. Even though you get a notecard, they're still tough. He expects you to learn the concepts more than the actual specifics of the problems. The online homework problems are taken from the textbook, so I recommend getting the solution guide. The TAs were above average.

Yes, his tests are hard but the curve helps a TON and he lets you have a notecard. He is great in lecture and office hours. I despised chemistry before this class, and I'm not saying its my whole world now, but I despise it a lot less and actually understand the material we covered and feel prepared for 104.
Really funny, always made class enojoyable and I hate chemistry. The exams may be hard but the curve makes it so at least half the class gets a B or better. Take him!

I thought Hutchison was a great professor, and he really knows his material.  He's also entertaining and passionate about chemistry.  While concepts are difficult at first, reading the book and doing the homework make it fairly easy.  His exams are a bit tough.  If you did take AP chemistry in high school you shouldn't have a problem.

He keeps lectures semi interesting but dosent cover material very thoroughly. The practice problems and quizzes give you a false sense that you understand the material then he makes the test as hard as he possibly can. I dont recommend him for chem 103.
Good Lecturer, funny guy. Not the best at explaining material, not the worst. Exams were EXTREMELY difficult. My TA was also horrible, though.  Don't get stuck with Linda Barry!
He's awesome! lectures are always entertaining, although the class definitely requires a lot of work.  exams are pretty tough, but you learn a lot. we all loved him!

He is a good lecturer but his exams are wicked tough because you could never figure out what is going on with the questions. I would say he does grade fairly but its up to your TA's way of grading. avoid the TA named Abruna, the way he grades labs is pretty unfair and will pull your grade down by alot
Funny teacher. Made lectures interesting with multiple experiments and a good sense of humor. Found exams pretty difficult, though. Questions were often unclear.

Lecture was sometimes boring, sometimes fun. Demos were good. Very pleasant professor, approachable, and knows the material. Slideshow was disorganized though, and he went through it too fast from time to time. Quizzes were satisfactory, tests were a little tricky, short assignments okay, and labs were EASY. Discussion section helps-go to it

Not great, the exam scores proved it.  I learned far more from the TA's, but Hutchison is a nice guy and pretty funny. I don't know if I would recommend him, but I am sure there are far worse professors.
Good lecturer, notes proved to be pretty helpful.  Fun guy, very likeable, cool demos.  I'd recommend him to anyone taking 103.
Fun to go to class, he's a funny dude and likes to do cool demonstrations. Always has a positive attitude. Good lecturer.
Awesome lecturer, the best I have had here at UW.  He is funny so class is always interesting.  Hutchison also like to do lots of demonstrations which are really interesting.  Take him if you can!!!!

It was his first year teaching 108 and it showed.  He copied the previous 108 teach's powerpoints and basically lectured their material, not his.  He's a good guy though and tries to make everything understandable.  That being said, I learned more in discussion (with Di-AWESOME GUY BTW!).  I'd recommend 108 if you can't fit 103/104 in your schedule

It was his first time teaching 108. He didn't do a very good job. He would move through slides to fast on formulas and spent too much time on useless information, like where he grew up. however! my TA was the best TA ever! Mark Lukowski! Try to get him as a TA!!
Difficult professor?hard to follow. Used lots of unnecessary periods.
Great professor, sometimes can be a little unclear but usually it gets clarified later. Go to lecture, you are fine. Has a tendency to goof off which makes lectures usually go by pretty fast.
Really like this professor, he's super helpful and doesn't overwhelm.  Has a sense of humor, too.

Good professor, but if you are decent at chemistry you don't need to go to lecture. Weekly quizzes in discussion and homework once a week. Exams are very fair and as long as you study you will get a good grade in the class
